en: Black‑and‑white image framed by the underside of a large stone bridge arch, looking across a river toward a hillside town. On the hill stands a large historic complex with castle‑like buildings and a church featuring tall spires and a tower with a dome roof. Below are smaller houses and riverside structures; in the foreground two people stand on the riverbank. The edges show damage and handwritten markings, typical of an early photographic postcard or plate.
